title: Incident Review Continuation
request: Continue the existing incident tracker from the prior phase. Add post-incident review readiness without replacing the in-memory API: incidents may have action items with owners and due dates, open and overdue action items must be listed deterministically, and summarizeIncidents must surface action-item counts, overdue counts, reviewStatus, and nextAction.
context: Phase 1 already delivered incident creation, assignment, resolution, listing, and a basic summary. The prior handoff is in docs/phase-1-incidents.md.
Action items belong to incidents and have id, title, owner, dueAt, and status. dueAt should be an ISO timestamp and should use the injectable now() clock for overdue checks.
Overdue action items are unresolved action items with dueAt before now(). Resolved incidents can still have open action items.
Do not add paging, external alert providers, persistence, or dependencies. Keep structured validation errors.
successCriteria: Existing incident tests continue to pass.
addActionItem accepts owner and dueAt and returns cloned action item data.
completeActionItem marks action items done without resolving the whole incident.
listOpenActionItems and listOverdueActionItems return deterministic action item lists.
summarizeIncidents adds openActionItemCount, overdueActionItemCount, reviewStatus, and nextAction.
